cohort: The cohort consisted of 17,825,445 hospitalized delivery patients in the United States between 2016 and 2020, with 1,185 of them having autoimmune hepatitis.
finding: Patients with autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) exhibited significantly higher rates of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes, including hypertension complications of pregnancy, preterm birth, fetal growth restriction, and fetal death, compared to hospitalized delivery patients without AIH.
mod_finding: AIH showed no association with cesarean section.
